users.title: User Profiles
users.description: User profile data and notification preferences

userHypotheses.title: User Hypotheses
userHypotheses.description: Scientific hypotheses saved or created by the user

userNotifications.title: User Notifications
userNotifications.description: Notifications sent to the user for completed AI processes or morning briefings

userBriefings.title: User Morning Briefings
userBriefings.description: Daily morning briefings generated for the user

securityRules: match /users/{userId} { allow read, write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId; }

match /userHypotheses/{docId} { allow read, write: if request.auth != null && (request.resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid || resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid); allow delete: if request.auth != null && resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid; }

match /userNotifications/{docId} { allow read, write: if request.auth != null && (request.resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid || resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid); allow delete: if request.auth != null && resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid; }
match /userBriefings/{docId} { allow read, write: if request.auth != null && (request.resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid || resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid); }
match /papers/{docId} { allow read, write: if request.auth != null; }
